title: Keep a legacy keyword alias and optional namespace with backward-compatible signature rules
prompt: Update lookup.py with backward-compatible signature rules so lookup(key=None, *, legacy_key=None, namespace=None) preserves existing positional calls, the key= keyword, and the legacy_key= keyword alias. Passing both key and legacy_key or omitting both must raise ValueError. When optional keyword-only namespace is supplied, validate it as an exact non-empty str (raising TypeError for non-str and ValueError for empty str) and include it under the 'namespace' field while preserving the existing 'key' field. Do not edit the protected acceptance file.
